ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. GSE students only. Blackboard Collaborate (also known as Elluminate) will be used. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM: Ed Policy St - UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
